Fiona Grant: quick shoutout  huge thanks to Elliot & Giselle for fixing the SSO redirect before Friday's customer walkthrough. you two are legends — saved the demo vibe :sparkles: :coffee:

Elliot Shaw: spotted a mis-encoded state param in the auth callback; patched the URL-encoding and pushed a hotfix. added a tiny unit test. :wrench:

Giselle Romero: i repro'd the flow in staging, replayed the oauth handshake, and validated cookie flags. left a short note in the runbook about the cookie-lifecycle nuance. :lock:

Samir Khan: ops-oncall here  warmed the auth-cache and monitored 2xx rates for 20m. all green. dropping a tin of hot chocolate + mini-marshmallows on the snack shelf for the rescue crew  please claim with a sticky note so we don't run out. :chocolate_bar:

Elliot Shaw: repro snippet i used locally:

Elliot Shaw: ```bash
# simulate auth callback with bad state encoding
curl -i -X GET 'https://app.staging.redwood.dev/auth/callback?state=a%5B1%5D&code=xyz' -H 'Host: staging.redwood.dev'
```

build-bot: deploy 2210: hotfix-sso promoted staging -> canary -> prod. auth-tests: passed. :white_check_mark:

Giselle Romero: also added a one-line integration test for the state param and a short note in auth-runbook. ping me if you want a quick walkthrough. :memo:

Fiona Grant: adding this to the weekly kudos under "SSO rescue crew". if anyone else helped and i missed you, drop your name here so i can include you. @culture-bot can you add a kudos for Elliot + Giselle? :tada:

culture-bot: kudos added: recipients: Elliot Shaw, Giselle Romero. Reason: "Patched SSO redirect issue that would've blocked a customer demo". :tada:

Samir Khan: reserved the last marshmallow for whoever pairs on a 10am postmortem doc with me tomorrow. coffee + cocoa included. :hot_pepper:

Elliot Shaw: i'll pair — and i'll take a marshmallow. high-fives all around. :raised_hands:

Giselle Romero: thanks team  tiny invisible saves are the best. :heart:
